effective_date_basis: The 'until' date in the order's own text when there is one; otherwise the separation or death date from an agency or Civil Service Commission record, or the date the governing statute changed; otherwise a stated gap.
ending_pattern: The order exempts one named employee from the compulsory retirement provisions. Some exemptions run until a stated date and end on it; many are open-ended (the exemplar states no period), and then the end depends on the employee's separation or death, or on a change in the governing retirement statute. A later order may extend a dated exemption.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Service performed under the exemption and resulting annuity rights are accrued effects (state transferred_or_accrued).

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
An extension order exists (the later order, not this one, carries the end).
No end date is stated and no separation record is held.
The exemption is open-ended (no stated period), as in the exemplar.

The governing retirement statute was amended or repealed (later Civil Service Retirement Act amendments; the statutory abolition of mandatory federal retirement in 1978): the order's authority may lapse before separation.
